summary: Frontend testing of 15 new Catholic prayers/devotions and companion deep-links. All 15 /prayer/{key} routes render correctly (no 'Prayer not found'). The 2 chaplets (st_joseph_chaplet, franciscan_crown) render the bead-by-bead stepper ('Bead 1 of N' with Next/Prev). The 13 reader devotions render prayer text and Good Work for Today. 15/15 companion deep-links navigate to the correct /prayer/{key}: st-joseph (Chaplet of St. Joseph -> st_joseph_chaplet, To you O blessed Joseph -> to_you_blessed_joseph), therese-lisieux (Little Way, Holy Face), blessed-virgin-mary (Little Office of the BVM), francis-assisi (Franciscan Crown), sts-peter-paul (Apostles' Creed, Chair of St Peter), thomas-aquinas (Tantum Ergo), john-the-baptist (Benedictus), guardian-angel (Angel of God), agnes (Litany of Virgin Martyrs, Consecration of Purity), sacred-heart (Act of Reparation), padre-pio (Stay with me Lord). All new prayers appear in the correct category listing pages: devotional (9), litany (litany_virgin_martyrs), marian (little_office_bvm), mass (stay_with_me_lord + tantum_ergo), chaplets (st_joseph_chaplet + franciscan_crown). Backend regression: GET /api/companions/{slug} confirmed returning correct '/prayer/{key}' routes for all 11 tested slugs. No React Native red-screen errors. Only pre-existing non-blocking warnings ('shadow*' style props deprecation, expo-notifications web listener warning) — not related to this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor inconsistency: DEVOTIONS.tantum_ergo has category:'devotional' in its object literal (devotions.ts line 501) but is placed under the 'mass' category in DEVOTION_CATEGORIES (line 508). Category listing behaves correctly (mass listing shows it) but the per-item .category field is stale/inconsistent with the manual grouping used for routing. Not a user-visible bug; consider aligning for future maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 15 new prayer keys (st_joseph_chaplet, franciscan_crown, to_you_blessed_joseph, angel_of_god, litany_virgin_martyrs, act_of_reparation, apostles_creed, chair_of_st_peter, stay_with_me_lord, the_little_way, holy_face, consecration_of_purity, benedictus, little_office_bvm, tantum_ergo) are wired up correctly in DEVOTIONS/CHAPLETS registries and DEVOTION_CATEGORIES groupings. Backend companions endpoint returns proper /prayer/{key} routes. Session token injection via localStorage 'sanctus_session_token' = 'test_feat_aug25' works for web testing.
